title: (optional) Implement blobext-03 server: Blob/set, Blob/get, Blob/lookup, Blob/convert
description: No server code exists. -03 behaviour to build in: blobs have no state (Blob/set rejects non-null ifInState with invalidArguments; old/newState null); dataSourceProperties default [blobId, offset, length]; digest names from the RFC 9530 registry, digest:* must be in supportedDigestAlgorithms (else invalidArguments), digest over exactly the returned octets; SetErrors invalidProperties/tooLarge/notFound; optional whole-blob size and digest:* on BlobCreateObject; BlobObject size null until a deferred convert result is generated, failed generation = not found everywhere; ExtractRecipe result id/type/size are the archive's; ArchiveEntry.created; Blob/lookup reference rules restored from RFC 9404 (Mailbox/Thread via Emails, Can Reference Blobs only, no undiscoverable ids).
